title: Phase 7 Action Plan
description: Validates a non-executing structured action plan for Phase 7 command-layer work. This schema describes a plan only; it does not execute commands, call providers, mutate runtime state, trigger deployments or replace human approval.

schemaVersion.description: Semantic version of this action plan schema contract.

planId.description: Deterministic, id-safe identifier for this non-executing action plan.

createdAt.description: UTC timestamp for when the action plan was created.

intent.description: Concise description of the command intent this plan prepares for review.

riskLevel.description: Risk level assigned before any downstream action is considered.

executionClass.description: Non-executing classification of the plan boundary.

requiresHumanApproval.description: Whether explicit human approval is required before any downstream action may proceed.

steps.description: Ordered, non-executing plan steps prepared for review.

stepId.description: Stable, id-safe identifier for the plan step.

order.description: Deterministic execution-review order for the step.

description.description: Reviewable description of the step. It must not contain executable shell commands, secrets, tokens or local machine paths.

allowed.description: Whether the step is allowed inside the documented safety boundary.

requiresApproval.description: Whether the step requires explicit human approval before any downstream action.

expectedResult.description: Expected non-executing review outcome for the step.

safetyGates.description: Safety gates that must be reviewed before the plan can advance.

gateId.description: Stable, id-safe identifier for the safety gate.

title.description: Short title for the safety gate.

required.description: Whether the gate is required for the plan to advance.

status.description: Current review status of the safety gate.

blocksProgress.description: Whether this gate currently blocks plan progress.

blockedStates.description: States that block the plan from advancing without execution.

expectedOutputs.description: Structured outputs expected from the non-executing plan.

outputId.description: Stable, id-safe identifier for the expected output.

description.description: Description of the expected non-executing output.

required.description: Whether this output is required for plan review.

forbiddenActions.description: Explicit actions forbidden for this plan, including execution, provider calls, runtime mutation and deployment triggers where relevant.

nonExecutableMetadata.description: Review and traceability metadata only. This object must not contain executable instructions, provider credentials, secrets, tokens, deployment actions or local machine paths.
